# Vendored Dependencies

This directory contains third-party libraries copied from their upstream
repositories. They are vendored (not git submodules) so the project always
builds offline with a known, locked version.

**Do not upgrade a library casually.** Every entry below records the upstream
source and version; bumping a version is a separate, reviewable change.

## Managed as regular git files

| Library | Upstream | Locked version | Form | Build integration |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Box2D | https://github.com/erincatto/box2d | **2.4.1** | source (static lib) | `premake5.lua` (local file), PCH enabled |
| GLAD | https://glad.dav1d.de (web generator) | **0.1.36**, OpenGL 4.6 core, generated 2026-02-11 | generated source (glad.c) | `premake5.lua` (local file); regenerate from the web tool, not a git repo |
| GLFW | https://github.com/glfw/glfw | **3.4.0** | source (static lib) | `premake5.lua` (local file), PCH enabled |
| ImGuizmo | https://github.com/CedricGuillemet/ImGuizmo | **v1.9** | source (compiled into Wheatear core) | `premake5.lua`; **local patch**: `ImGuizmo.cpp` starts with `#include "wtpch.h"` for the engine PCH |
| entt | https://github.com/skypjack/entt | **4.0.0** | header-only (`entt.hpp`) | include path only |
| glm | https://github.com/g-truc/glm | **0.9.9.4** | header-only | include path only |
| imgui | https://github.com/ocornut/imgui | **v1.92.9** | source (static lib) | `premake5.lua` (local file; upstream ships one too), PCH enabled |
| miniaudio | https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio | **0.11.25** | single header (impl in `AudioEngine.cpp` via `MINIAUDIO_IMPLEMENTATION`) | include path only |
| mono | https://github.com/mono/mono | **≈6.12.0.x** (prebuilt 2023-10-27) | prebuilt static lib + C headers | `premake/common.lua` `Library.mono_*`; upstream tree is 1GB+, only headers+libs are vendored |
| spdlog | https://github.com/gabime/spdlog | **1.17.0** | header-only | include path only; was briefly a submodule, now regular files (see below) |
| stb_image | https://github.com/nothings/stb | **v2.30** | single header + local wrapper | `stb_image.cpp` (local file): `#define STB_IMAGE_IMPLEMENTATION` + include |
| tinyobjloader | https://github.com/tinyobjloader/tinyobjloader | **≈1.0.6** | single header (impl in `Mesh.cpp` via `TINYOBJLOADER_IMPLEMENTATION`) | include path only |
| yaml-cpp | https://github.com/jbeder/yaml-cpp | **0.6.3** | source (static lib) | `premake5.lua` (local file), PCH enabled |

## History / decisions

- **Submodules rejected**: the libraries either carry local patches (premake
  scripts, the ImGuizmo PCH include, the stb_image wrapper) or are generated
  artifacts (GLAD) / prebuilt binaries (mono). Submoduling them would add
  network dependence to every clone and require patch management. A prior
  half-converted submodule (`spdlog`, registered but never initialized) was
  removed — the directory is tracked as regular files again, so
  `git submodule update` can no longer overwrite the working copy.
- **Premake-generated files are not committed**: `*.vcxproj` / `*.filters`
  inside these library dirs are regenerated by `premake5 vs2022` and are
  git-ignored (see root `.gitignore`).
- **Mono duplication is intentional**: `Wheatear/vendor/mono` holds the
  embedded-runtime C headers + prebuilt `libmono-static-sgen.lib`, while
  `WheatearEditor/mono` holds the .NET 4.5 reference assemblies for C#
  script compilation. The two trees do not overlap.

## Upgrade notes

- **yaml-cpp 0.6.3** and **tinyobjloader 1.0.6** are older upstream releases.
  Upgrading changes their APIs; evaluate as a separate task before touching
  the serialization / mesh loading code.
- When vendoring a new library: copy the tree, remove non-build artifacts
  (docs/examples/tests), record it in the table above, and keep any local
  patches minimal and documented.
